item.title: AI digest — 2026-09-17
item.description:
Do this week

  • Copilot code review got shell tools + ensemble Lite: review agents can run builds/tests behind the agent firewall — treat review as higher privilege near secrets/IaC; fold review wait and tokens into $/merged PR.
  • Still: enterprise-managed Copilot agent permissions — ask/deny shell + network on TF/secrets repos; app-code can stay looser. Managed rules cannot be bypassed.
  • Gate agent MCPs/skills/plugins like packages (allowlists); agents pull dependencies without a human in the loop.

Watch

  • GitHub HydraFusion research preview: cascade/critique routing for quality at ~36–67% lower estimated cost vs Opus 5 — model-neutral task-shape routing for token-cost standards.
  • Sourcegraph Agentic Batch Changes GA (Cloud now; self-hosted with 8.0): pay per merged changeset; agent reacts to CI failures — no unsupervised auto-merge.
  • Coder Agents GA + Agent Relay for Claude Code (Sep 15): corp-ready self-hosted execution with RBAC/audit; Relay still early access.
  • Anthropic CI 25× in six months — plan test-selection capacity for 10–20× as agents scale.

item.title: AI digest — 2026-09-16
item.description:
Do this week

  • Copilot enterprise-managed agent permissions: for TF/Scalr + secrets repos, require approval (or block) on shell + network; app-code can stay looser.
  • Keep premium/agentic models off-by-default pending metered pilots; use Auto Efficiency for autocomplete-shaped work.
  • As coding agents grow, treat CI wait as part of $/merged PR — no auto-approve on IaC/secrets.

Watch

  • Anthropic CI scale story (agentic coding straining CI) — plan capacity for 10–20×.
  • OpenAI “software factory” multi-agent review patterns (contrast only; they have unlimited tokens).
  • Atlassian governed agent loops (early access).
